decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Elf cartographer with pointed ears, long braid, leaf-shaped shoulder pieces over a green quilted tunic, cream underlayer, leather belt with a round clasp and pouches, bracers, fitted trousers, cuffed boots and a strapped map tube across the back. The rear views confirm the tube, straps and quilting continue around the body. Rigged: 24-bone humanoid armature, walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin (Meshy) is disclosed upstream; some storefronts require AI-content disclosure.
The map tube is fused to the back and cannot be opened or removed.
No map or scroll is included as a separate prop.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. King in a red velvet doublet with frogged fastenings, a white ermine cape with a modelled fur border, a metal crown, engraved bracers, cream trousers and tall cuffed boots. The cape's fur trim and the doublet back are complete geometry and the crown is a separate-looking but fused ring with points. Rigged: 24-bone humanoid armature, walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin (Meshy) is disclosed upstream; some storefronts require AI-content disclosure.
The cape is skinned to the shoulders, not cloth-simulated, so it will not swing freely.
The crown cannot be removed without editing the mesh.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Businessman in a teal three-piece pinstripe suit with a waistcoat, orange tie and pocket square, white shirt, and brown leather shoes. Lapels, vents, cuff buttons and the jacket's rear vent are modelled; the pinstripe stays aligned across panels. Clean-shaven face with defined hair and beard stubble. Rigged: 24-bone humanoid armature, walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin (Meshy) is disclosed upstream; some storefronts require AI-content disclosure.
Semi-stylized proportions rather than a photoreal scan.
The jacket is skinned to the body and cannot be removed.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Long-necked brass ewer with a squat bulbous base, a tall tapering neck, a pinched pouring lip and a thin strap handle from lip to shoulder. Engraved floral bands run around the neck, shoulder and base and the top view confirms the open throat and spout. Title corrected: this is a handled ewer, not a bulbous vase.
limitations: The handle is slender geometry and may alias at distance.
Engraving is ornament only, with no lettering or maker's mark.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Racing stripes carry no numbers or sponsor marks.. Panel gaps, glazing, lamp lenses, wheel arches and the underside floorpan are all modelled, and the top and bottom views confirm a closed body with no missing faces. No brand badge, wordmark or number plate appears anywhere.
limitations: Stylized, not photoreal: this is a Cozy-kit vehicle with a simplified pastel palette.
Wheels are separate objects pivoted on their hubs, so they can be rolled; the body itself is not rigged.
Interior is simplified; not suitable for a close-up cabin shot.
